Suelo cargar nafta seguido y es la única YPF en donde los playeros son extremadamente soberbios. Cuando uno estaciona puede qudarse esperando un largo rato sin que aparezca el playero porque te atienden cuando quieren, tardan una eternidad para cargarte nafta y después para cobrarte. En cualquier otra YPF ocurre exactamente lo contrario

(Translated by Google)
I fill up there often, and this is the only YPF where the attendants are incredibly arrogant. When you park, you can wait a long time without an attendant appearing because they only serve you when they feel like it. It takes forever to pump your gas and then to take your money. At any other YPF, it's the exact opposite.

reviews.comment:
Increíble que cuando un playero te atiende bien y querés dejarle una propina , que te ofrecen la posibilidad de hacerlo por ejemplo con Mercado Pago, nunca le llegue al empleado. Yo no le quiero dejar al ACA sepa quiero dejar al playero. Una vergüenza. Quien se queda con algo que no le corresponde?. Tener que solicitarle al empleado su alias para dejarle una propina teniendo la opción con QR? Una vergüenza. En fin. Son patéticos por no decir otra cosa. Horribles.

(Translated by Google)
It's unbelievable that when a gas station attendant gives you good service and you want to leave a tip, even though they offer the option to do so with Mercado Pago, for example, the employee never receives it. I don't want to leave a tip for the gas station attendant; I want to leave one for the attendant. It's a disgrace. Who's keeping something that doesn't belong to them? Having to ask the employee for their username to leave a tip when there's a QR code option? It's shameful. In short, they're pathetic, to say the least. Horrible.
